title: Turning Threading: a SolidCraft part with a modelled M16x1.5 thread cannot be threaded (STEP: 'mesh is open ... dangling chord ends'; .sc: 'every axis fits this model equally')

labels.name: in-review

body:
Found by the release QA swarm (#2582) on **v0.24.0** with SolidCraft 0.45.0, driven through MCP by a Codex agent. Part: turned pin, Ø30 head / Ø24 body / M16x1.5 x 17 external thread with relief, 70 long, Tormach 15L Slant-PRO, Tormach PathPilot Lathe post.

## What happens
Threading says it cuts a modelled thread (`threading cuts a MODELED thread (a revolved V section); a smooth bar has none to find`). A real modelled thread from SolidCraft (`solid.thread`, `designation:"M16x1.5"`, `modeled:true`) cannot be threaded either way it is brought in:

1. **STEP** (`q03-turn-shaft-modeled.step`, imports 14388 facets with no reduced-fidelity warning):
   `M16Modeled: the source model cannot be sliced: the mesh is open at z = 16.687498017218555: 4 dangling chord ends`
   An STL exported from the same body is watertight (checked at 1e-6..1e-4 mm), so the open chain looks like CamCraft's tessellation/slicing of the helical faces.
2. **Native .sc** (`q03-turn-shaft.sc`, 29022 facets):
   `M16Native: invalid machining parameters: every axis fits this model equally - it curves the same the world around; domed ground is 5-Axis Contour or Parallel work`
   The part is a 30 x 30 x 70 turned shaft on Z; compare #152 (same message, cross hole).

On the smooth-envelope model the thread op generates, but verify then holds the post as `finish envelope near move 198: 0.9201 mm gouge, 8.0000 mm rest` (correctly - the model has no thread). So there is no route to a posted single-point thread from a SolidCraft part.

## Expected
A turned part with a modelled helical thread finds the Z axis and threads; or the refusal says plainly that helical models are not read yet and what to model instead.

## Reproduce (on skull)
- `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q03-turn-shaft/modeled-step-slice-failure.camproj` -> `open_project`, `generate {name:"M16Modeled"}`
- `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q03-turn-shaft/modeled-native-thread-test.camproj` -> `open_project`, `generate {name:"M16Native"}`
- smooth model: `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q03-turn-shaft/q03-turn-shaft.camproj` -> `verify {}`
Report: `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q03-turn-shaft/REPORT.md` (problems 2-4), calls in `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q03-turn-shaft/STEPS.log`.

Related: #893 (no catalog insert fits M16x1.5: 0.866 too narrow, 1.732 too wide), #2879, #2880.

Not checked on current main.

Done means: the STEP and .sc versions of this part each either thread and post, or are refused with a message that names the helical thread as the reason; pinned by tests on a recorded mesh.
